summary.text: Matt Hanson has represented the 83rd District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography describes Hanson as an engineer with BNSF Railway and an officer of SMART-TD Local 171.
Hanson holds a B.S. in business administration from the University of Richmond and is a former member of the Kane County Board and the Kane County Forest Preserve Commission.
